prompts.title: Quiet Intensity
prompts.prompt:
Create a photorealistic 4:5 vertical cinematic portrait of the uploaded male subject, framed from the mid-chest upward in a refined, premium editorial style.

Composition & Pose
Show the subject in a chest-up / upper-torso portrait.
The pose must be a clear three-quarter side pose, not front-facing. His torso should be noticeably angled to one side, while his face is turned downward in the same direction. The subject should feel naturally turned, not squared toward the camera.
The shoulders must not appear flat or perfectly level. Keep a natural asymmetry in the shoulders, with the body softly slanted so the pose feels elegant and realistic. Avoid a straight, centered, passport-like posture.

Expression — Very Important
The subject should have a quiet, introspective, deeply focused expression — calm lips, relaxed facial muscles, slightly lowered eyelids, and a subtle sense of concentration or reflection. He should look serious and emotionally present, not sad, not smiling, not blank, and not overly dramatic.

Styling
Dress him in a black high-neck turtleneck layered under a dark brown blazer with clean structure and soft premium fabric texture. Add black rectangular eyeglasses with a polished frame, sitting naturally on the face.

Lighting & Neon Halo
Behind the subject’s head, place a large glowing circular neon ring light in a vivid orange-red tone, positioned like a luminous halo and clearly visible around the head and shoulders.
Use this neon ring as the key visual element:
Strong warm orange rim light along the hair edges, ear, cheek contour, jawline, neck, and blazer shoulder
Soft warm reflections on the eyeglass frame and lens edges
Controlled highlights on the skin without overexposure
Deep, rich shadows on the front and lower parts of the outfit for a dramatic cinematic contrast
Face, Skin & Detail Quality
Render the subject with crisp realistic facial detail, natural skin texture, subtle pores, fine facial hair detail where present, clean eyebrow definition, realistic hair strands, and sharp optical clarity around the eyes, glasses, and nose bridge. The image should feel like a high-end studio portrait, not smooth, plastic, or AI-stylized.

Background
Use a dark moody studio background in deep black and charcoal tones, with a soft atmospheric falloff around the glowing neon ring. Keep the background minimal and uncluttered so the neon circle and subject remain dominant. Do not add smoke, haze, fog, texture buildup, or extra atmospheric effects.

Visual Style
Premium cinematic portrait photography, dramatic low-key lighting, neon editorial aesthetic, ultra-detailed, sharp focus on face and glasses, realistic depth of field, polished high-end color grading, rich contrast, sophisticated masculine mood.
